name: assistant
title: Assistant
description: Full-page assistant laid out by the kai-workspace shell: the kai-conversations rail (built-in header, search and New chat) in the start aside, with the resize handle between the columns, a collapse the shell performs so main reflows, and an overlay drawer below the breakpoint. Main carries the kai-model-switcher recipe in its top bar, kai-thread and kai-prompt-input, and the headless conversation controller over local storage. Ships with a scripted mock so the thread demos reasoning, a settled tool call and citations on first paint.
docs: Runs against a scripted local mock out of the box - no endpoint, no key. The transport is one file, assistant.transport.ts: the scripted mock in the default mode, a POST to /api/chat with --gateway, a loud stub with --no-mock. Replace it with your own to go live, and keep parsing through the @kitn.ai/ui/wire readers.
